claim.claim-text: The briefcase-deployed flight exosuit system (2700) of claim 78, further comprising dual forearm-mounted weapon pods (2714) each integrating a tri-mode atmospheric-condensing projectile launcher and a retractable 0.42 m magnetically confined plasma blade powered directly from said dorsal closed-loop power core (2708) and supercapacitor buffer (2710).

The briefcase-deployed flight exosuit system (2700) of claim 78, wherein said air-gapped neural-command helmet (2716) further includes a somatic piezo-electromyography muscle-override circuit configured to hardware-gate motor and thruster commands within 0.4 ms upon involuntary muscle flinch or cryptographic key mismatch.

The load-bearing neural-controlled multi-tentacle exoskeleton system (2800) of claim 81, wherein each multi-fingered omni-claw (2806) integrates a magnetically focused micro-plasma torch and a 120-bar high-pressure nozzle fed by distilled water and oxygen generated by said dual closed-loop power cores (2816).

The load-bearing neural-controlled multi-tentacle exoskeleton system (2800) of claim 81, wherein said dorsal chassis (2802) further comprises deployable ballistic and thermal shield panels driven by said continuum tentacles (2804) and cooled by closed-loop 37 degrees Celsius micro-channel fluid circulation.
